description: This file implements multipart protocol parsing, including boundary detection, header parsing, and part extraction, building on a message parser. It defines classes for parameter parsing and multipart message parsing, handling multipart content types in HTTP.

classes.name: uWS::ParameterParser
classes.description: Parses key-value parameters from a line, typically from content-disposition headers in multipart data.

classes.name: uWS::MultipartParser
classes.description: Parses multipart HTTP request bodies, extracting individual parts based on boundary markers, and parsing headers within each part.

methods.name: ParameterParser::getKeyValue
methods.description: Returns the next key-value pair from the parameter line, with value possibly empty.

methods.name: ParameterParser::getToken
methods.description: Consumes and returns the next token from the line, handling quoted strings and operators.

methods.name: MultipartParser::MultipartParser
methods.description: Constructs the parser, extracting boundary from content type.

methods.name: MultipartParser::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the multipart parser has a valid boundary.

methods.name: MultipartParser::setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content to be parsed.

methods.name: MultipartParser::getNextPart
methods.description: Extracts the next part from the multipart body, parsing headers and returning the part data.
